shared_elements: bearded male figure in strict profile
elaborately curled/patterned hair and beard rendered in rows
low relief with flat plane and modelled forms
figure gripping a long slender staff/spear vertically with fist
procession-style human figures facing one direction
patterned surface infill (fleece scales, pleated drapery, hair curls) rendered as regular repeated units
justification: Both show bearded men in strict profile with tightly stylised rows of curls in hair and beard, carved in shallow relief with regular repeated-unit infill (fleece scales in A, pleated robe folds and curls in B), and both depict a figure grasping a long vertical shaft; the processional, single-direction orientation is common to both. The biggest difference in content is that A is a multi-figure tribute-bearing scene with rams, a tree and a rosette border, while B is a single isolated, crowned and elaborately robed figure with weapons and no animals or vegetal motifs.
